market.title: Will Jon Rahm leave LIV Golf by June 30th?

ancillaryText:
q: title: Will Jon Rahm leave LIV Golf by June 30th?, description: This market will resolve to “Yes” if the listed player formally ceases membership with LIV Golf, and ceases participation in LIV Golf events by June 30, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

If the listed player makes an official announcement regarding their intention to join another tour before the aforementioned date, the corresponding market will resolve to “Yes”, regardless of when that change takes effect. If LIV Golf ceases operations entirely within the declared timeframe, the corresponding market will resolve to “Yes”.

If LIV Golf announces a merger or acquisition with another competition, the corresponding market will resolve to “No”, even if the player’s tour membership transfers to a successor entity.

The resolution source for this market will be official information from LIV, the acquiring competition, and/or the listed player; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used. market_id: 1992979 res_data: p1: 0, p2: 1, p3: 0.5. Where p1 corresponds to No, p2 to Yes, p3 to unknown/50-50.
